disclosure_line: Photos digitally enhanced and staged for lighting and presentation. Room size, layout, fixtures and furniture are as is.
base: Edit this exact photo of a real Singapore rental room into a clean, bright, photorealistic listing photo. Keep the camera position and the room exactly as it is: same walls, windows, doors, floor, ceiling, built in wardrobes, aircon unit, switches and every fixed feature. Keep every piece of furniture in its current position and at its current size. Do not enlarge the room and do not invent space, windows or doors that are not there. Give the image a slightly wider field of view, like a 16mm to 18mm wide angle lens, by revealing only what is naturally at the edges of this room. Brighten the scene with soft natural daylight, neutral white balance, gentle even shadows and no blown highlights. Remove clutter: personal belongings, bags, boxes, luggage, laundry, cables, papers, packaging, toys, ornaments and small items on floors and surfaces. Keep the result honest: no renovation, no new flooring, no new wall colour, no new furniture, no people, no text or watermarks. Output a sharp, natural, magazine quality photo with the same aspect ratio as the source.

rooms.bedroom: This is a bedroom. Keep the bed frame, mattress size and bed position exactly as they are. Dress the bed with fresh, neatly made plain bedding (fitted sheet, duvet and two pillows) in one calm neutral colour chosen to match the wall tone: white, off white, light grey or soft beige. Replace patterned or mismatched curtains with plain curtains in a colour that complements the walls, hung at the same window at the same size. Add one or two small indoor plants, for example a potted plant on the floor beside the wardrobe or a small plant on the desk or side table, placed where they do not hide any feature. Remove soft toys, personal photos and decorations. Keep the desk, chair and wardrobe as they are but clear their surfaces.
rooms.living_room: This is a living room or common area. Keep the sofa, dining set, television, cabinets and shelves exactly where they are and at the same size. Straighten cushions and throws, clear tables and shelves of personal items, photos of people, toys, remotes, bottles and papers, and remove anything stored on the floor. Add one medium indoor plant in a free corner or beside the sofa. Keep the display cabinet contents tidy but do not add new furniture or artwork.
rooms.kitchen: This is a kitchen. Keep cabinets, countertop, sink, hob, hood, fridge and appliances exactly as they are. Clear the countertop of small appliances, dishes, bottles, food packaging, cloths and utensils, leaving at most one kettle or one neutral item. Clean all surfaces, tiles and the hob. Do not place plants on the hob or sink; a small herb plant on a clear counter end is fine. Do not change the cabinet colour or add new appliances.
rooms.bathroom: This is a bathroom or toilet. Keep all sanitary fittings, tiles, mirror, shower area and water heater exactly as they are. Remove toiletries, bottles, brushes, towels, mats, bins and hoses. Clean the tiles, mirror, glass and fittings so they look dry and spotless. Do not add plants unless there is a clear shelf, and never change the fittings or tiles.
rooms.storage_or_corridor: This is a corridor, entrance or storage corner of the unit. Keep the wardrobe, shoe cabinet and any fixed features exactly as they are. Clear the floor completely of luggage, bags, boxes, ironing boards and hanging items. Leave the walls plain. One small floor plant is optional if there is clear space that does not narrow the walkway.
rooms.exterior: This is the building exterior, corridor outside the unit or a view from the window. Enhance only: brighten, correct white balance, straighten verticals and sharpen. Do not add, remove or move anything.

negative: no people, no faces, no text, no watermark, no logo, no extra windows or doors, no change to room dimensions, no change to bed size, no new flooring, no new wall colour, no cartoon or painterly look, no over saturated colours, no fisheye distortion
notes: Room type is classified before prompting (local moondream or the harvest classifier); if unsure, use storage_or_corridor rules without staging.
Originals are never overwritten. Enhanced files are saved as <n>_staged.jpg beside the original and a ledger records model, prompt version, credits and date.
Every listing that shows a staged photo carries the disclosure line on the public site, the Matchmaker card and the portal description.
1K output at 2 credits per image on the creator plan as of 7 Sep 2026.
